include: Matches the population, intervention or phenomenon of interest
Addresses at least one of the research themes
Peer-reviewed journal article, review, or book chapter
exclude: No relevance to the research themes
Wrong publication type (editorial, abstract, book review)

rules.name: Not in an accepted language
rules.note: Records whose language the source does not know are kept by default, because unknown is not the same as not-English.

rules.name: No abstract available
rules.note: Off by default. These can only be screened on the title, but some are real papers whose publisher withholds abstracts — Elsevier especially. Read the titles before switching this on.

rules.name: Old and never cited
rules.note: Off by default. After this long, zero citations is no longer explained by the paper being recent, so it is a real signal — but it still removes work that is simply in a quiet venue.

rules.name: Outside the region of interest
rules.note: Off by default, and only does anything once you name regions in the config. `basis` is text, affiliation or both; keep_unknown keeps records whose affiliation is unrecorded, because unknown is not the same as elsewhere.
